# WebToolNest

> 170+ free online tools that run entirely in the browser: PDF, image, video and audio converters, calculators, student, developer and everyday utilities. No sign-up, no watermarks, no limits, and files are processed on the visitor's own device instead of being uploaded.

- Website: https://www.webtoolnest.com/
- Contact: contact@webtoolnest.com
- Every tool is free and works on phones and computers.

## PDF Tools

Merge, split, compress, convert, sign and edit PDF files online for free. Everything runs in your browser, so your documents are never uploaded.

- [Merge PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one document. Reorder the files before merging and download a single PDF — free, fast and private.
- [Split PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/split-pdf): Split a PDF into single pages or extract custom page ranges such as 1-3, 5, 8-10 into separate PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size to meet email and upload limits. Pick a compression level and compare the before and after size.
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert every page of a PDF into high-quality JPG or PNG images. Download single pages or all pages as a ZIP.
- [PDF to PNG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/pdf-to-png): Convert PDF pages to sharp, lossless PNG images online. Free, no sign-up and your file never leaves your device.
- [JPG to PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/jpg-to-pdf): Turn JPG, PNG, WebP and other images into one PDF. Choose page size, orientation and margins.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.webtoolnest.com/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Word (DOCX) files. Text and paragraphs are extracted so you can edit them in Word or Google Docs.
- [Word to PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/word-to-pdf): Convert Microsoft Word DOCX documents to PDF while keeping fonts, headings, tables and images.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/rotate-pdf): Rotate all pages or selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees and save the result permanently.
- [Organize PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/organize-pdf): Reorder, rotate and delete PDF pages visually using page thumbnails, then save a new PDF.
- [Delete PDF Pages](https://www.webtoolnest.com/delete-pdf-pages): Remove unwanted pages from a PDF by entering page numbers or ranges, and download the cleaned file.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/add-page-numbers): Insert page numbers into a PDF. Choose the position, format (1, Page 1, 1 of N), font size and starting number.
- [Watermark PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/watermark-pdf): Stamp a text watermark such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT on every page of a PDF with your own opacity, size, color and angle.
- [PDF to Text](https://www.webtoolnest.com/pdf-to-text): Extract all the text from a PDF file. Copy it to the clipboard or download it as a TXT file.
- [Sign PDF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/sign-pdf): Add your signature to a PDF online. Draw or type a signature, place it on any page and download the signed document.
- [PDF Booklet Maker](https://www.webtoolnest.com/pdf-booklet-maker): Turn any PDF into a printable booklet. Pages are rearranged two per sheet so you can print double-sided, fold in half and staple — with A4, Letter, signatures and right-to-left support.

## Image Tools

Compress, resize, crop and convert images, remove backgrounds, extract text and make memes and collages — free and private.

- [Compress Image](https://www.webtoolnest.com/compress-image): Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP image size by up to 80% while keeping good quality. Compress many images at once or target an exact size in KB.
- [Resize Image](https://www.webtoolnest.com/resize-image): Resize images to exact pixel dimensions or by percentage. Keep the aspect ratio and resize many photos in one go.
- [Crop Image](https://www.webtoolnest.com/crop-image): Crop photos online with free-form or fixed aspect ratios like 1:1, 4:3 and 16:9, or crop to a circle for profile pictures.
- [Image Converter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/image-converter): Convert images between JPG, PNG and WebP. Batch convert multiple files and download them all as a ZIP.
- [PNG to JPG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG images to JPG online for free. Transparent areas are filled with white or a color you choose.
- [JPG to PNG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG and JPEG photos to lossless PNG images online, in bulk and for free.
- [WebP to JPG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images to JPG so they open everywhere. Batch convert and download as ZIP.
- [WebP to PNG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/webp-to-png): Convert WebP images to PNG with transparency preserved. Free, fast and private.
- [JPG to WebP](https://www.webtoolnest.com/jpg-to-webp): Convert JPG and PNG images to WebP for faster websites — smaller files with the same visual quality.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC and HEIF photos to JPG or PNG so you can open and share them on any device.
- [Rotate & Flip Image](https://www.webtoolnest.com/rotate-image): Rotate images by 90° steps or any custom angle, and flip them horizontally or vertically.
- [Background Remover](https://www.webtoolnest.com/remove-background): Remove the background from photos automatically with AI. Download a transparent PNG or add a new background color.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](https://www.webtoolnest.com/image-to-text): Extract text from images, screenshots and scanned documents with OCR. Supports English, Urdu, Arabic, Hindi and many more languages.
- [Image to Base64](https://www.webtoolnest.com/image-to-base64): Convert images to Base64 data URIs for HTML and CSS, or decode a Base64 string back into an image.
- [Add Watermark to Image](https://www.webtoolnest.com/watermark-image): Add a text or logo watermark to your photos with custom position, size, opacity and color.
- [Photo Editor & Filters](https://www.webtoolnest.com/photo-filters): Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and blur, or apply grayscale, sepia and invert filters to your photos.
- [Meme Generator](https://www.webtoolnest.com/meme-generator): Make memes by adding top and bottom text to any image. Change font size, color and outline, then download.
- [Favicon Generator](https://www.webtoolnest.com/favicon-generator): Create favicon.ico and PNG app icons in every standard size from an image, text or an emoji.
- [Image Color Picker](https://www.webtoolnest.com/image-color-picker): Pick colors from any image and get HEX, RGB and HSL codes. Also extracts the main color palette of the picture.
- [SVG to PNG](https://www.webtoolnest.com/svg-to-png): Convert SVG vector graphics to PNG or JPG images at any size, with a transparent or colored background.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://www.webtoolnest.com/passport-photo-maker): Make passport and visa photos in standard sizes like 2x2 inch and 35x45 mm, then print several on a 4x6 sheet.
- [Photo Collage Maker](https://www.webtoolnest.com/collage-maker): Combine multiple photos into a collage grid with custom spacing, rounded corners and background color.
- [Instagram Grid Maker & Image Splitter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/image-splitter): Split one photo into a 3, 6 or 9-post Instagram grid or a seamless swipe carousel. Tiles are cut to 1:1, 4:5 or 3:4 and numbered in posting order.
- [Split Image into 3 for Instagram](https://www.webtoolnest.com/split-image-for-instagram): Split a wide photo into 3 square posts that line up as one picture across your Instagram profile row.
- [Instagram Carousel Splitter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/instagram-carousel-splitter): Turn a panorama into a seamless Instagram carousel — the picture continues as people swipe from slide to slide.

## Video & Audio

Convert, compress and trim videos, extract MP3 audio, cut ringtones, record your screen and voice, and turn text into speech.

- [Video Converter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/video-converter): Convert videos between MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV and AVI formats right in your browser — no upload and no watermark.
- [Video Compressor](https://www.webtoolnest.com/video-compressor): Reduce video file size by lowering resolution and bitrate. Ideal for WhatsApp, email and Discord upload limits.
- [Video to MP3](https://www.webtoolnest.com/video-to-mp3): Extract the audio track from any video and save it as MP3, WAV or M4A.
- [MP4 to MP3](https://www.webtoolnest.com/mp4-to-mp3): Convert MP4 videos to MP3 audio online. Free, fast and private — your video is processed on your device.
- [Video Trimmer](https://www.webtoolnest.com/video-trimmer): Cut and trim videos online by choosing a start and end time. Fast trimming for MP4, WebM, MOV and more.
- [Video to GIF](https://www.webtoolnest.com/video-to-gif): Turn video clips into animated GIFs. Choose the start time, length, width and frame rate.
- [Audio Converter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/audio-converter): Convert audio files between MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC and FLAC formats.
- [MP3 Cutter](https://www.webtoolnest.com/mp3-cutter): Cut MP3 and other audio files to make ringtones or clips, with optional fade in and fade out.
- [Mute Video](https://www.webtoolnest.com/mute-video): Remove the audio track from a video file without re-encoding the picture, so quality stays the same.
- [Screen Recorder](https://www.webtoolnest.com/screen-recorder): Record your screen, an app window or a browser tab with system audio and microphone. No install and no watermark.
- [Voice Recorder](https://www.webtoolnest.com/voice-recorder): Record audio from your microphone online and download it as WAV or WebM.
- [Webcam Test](https://www.webtoolnest.com/webcam-test): Check if your webcam works, see its resolution and frame rate, take snapshots and record short clips.
- [Mic Test](https://www.webtoolnest.com/mic-test): Test your microphone online with a live volume meter, then record and play back a short sample.
- [Text to Speech](https://www.webtoolnest.com/text-to-speech): Convert text to natural-sounding speech with different voices, languages, speed and pitch.
- [Speech to Text](https://www.webtoolnest.com/speech-to-text): Type with your voice. Convert speech to text in real time in many languages, then copy or download it.

- [Typing Speed Test](https://www.webtoolnest.com/typing-speed-test): Test your typing speed in words per minute (WPM) and accuracy with 15-second to 10-minute tests, a punctuation mode, a speed chart and the keys you mistype most.

- [5 Minute Typing Test](https://www.webtoolnest.com/5-minute-typing-test): Take a 5 minute typing test for an accurate words-per-minute score, with accuracy, CPM and a speed chart.
